name: faa-notam
description: Retrieve FAA NOTAMs through a local MCP stdio server with file-based credentials.

interface.longDescription: Find NOTAMs around airports or along flight corridors using FAA airport and VFR waypoint data. Filter out notices below a specified altitude, retrieve checklists and save bulk snapshots. Runs locally over MCP stdio with credentials and the FAA environment URL in a local configuration file.
defaultPrompt: Find NOTAMs within 25 NM of KSEA.
Find NOTAMs within 10 NM of KSEA to KPDX at 5500 feet MSL.
